settings.a_note: a frozen at the value chosen by leave-one-year-out over 2012-2019 on the development regions, a_jm at the value chosen over 2018/2019 for J-M; the confirmation refits A2 with these and tunes nothing
settings.bootstrap_r: year blocks over the training years of the fit, resampled with replacement
settings.bootstrap_s: month blocks over 2018-04..2019-12, resampled with replacement
settings.ratio_fallback: group -> region x day/night -> all regions x day/night (a one-region table: the region)
settings.alpha: NB2 maximum likelihood per region x day/night, means held at the fitted r*V and b, log alpha in [-20, 6]
settings.predictive_distribution: R1/Rm: negative binomial moment-matched to mean and NB variance + V^2 Var(r); A2: A's Poisson-gamma (NB for V > 0, Poisson(b) for V = 0)
settings.interval_of_a_total: mean +/- 1.2816 sd; sd^2 = summed NB variances + bootstrap variance of the total
settings.rows: cell x month x day/night from 2012-02 for every cell with a MODIS, Suomi NPP or NOAA-20 detection in 2012-02..2019-12; region box from pipeline/regions.py; bake-off filters
settings.outage_rule_test1: MODIS 0 while Suomi NPP >= 50, or Suomi NPP 0 while MODIS >= 50 (regions combined)
settings.outage_rule_swap: Suomi NPP 0 while NOAA-20 >= 50, or NOAA-20 0 while Suomi NPP >= 50 (regions combined)
